title: RepoAttachRequested
description: Someone asked HOTL to attach a repo, or to change an attached repo's profile: the onboarder proposes a profile (or the one given is proposed as is) and the architect approves it through a rule brief (ADR 0013). Topic hotl.intent; subject and key: the attachment id, for example ATT-0001. Producer: Intake. Main consumers: Orchestrator (starts the attachment).

profile.description: A profile written by hand (JSON, per documents/repo-profile.schema.json) to propose instead of asking the onboarder for one.
